Subscribe to receive new crypto airdrops with your assets.
Who’s eligible for the Flash Earn (Stake to Earn) campaign?
As Flash Earn (Stake to Earn) is a flexible product, you can redeem your funds anytime after subscription. You can redeem from either the campaign landing page or under Assets > Earn.

When the campaign ends, if you haven’t redeemed manually, we’ll automatically reinvest eligible crypto (such as USDT, OKB, and many others) into Simple Earn. Any unsupported crypto will be returned to your Funding account within 2 hours.
You’ll receive two types of rewards:
(1) an airdrop of a newly-listed token (principal-protected), and
(2) a base reward in your subscription crypto that’s generated with Simple Earn.
Simple Earn rewards begin in the second hour after your funds are lent out. If not lent out, no rewards are generated.
Airdrop rewards for newly listed tokens also begin up to 2 hours after subscription.
If you redeem your funds within one hour after subscription, you won’t earn any rewards for that hour.
Rewards are distributed hourly. Rewards from a one-hour period will be distributed in the following hour after calculations are completed.
For example, rewards for the time period of 3:00 UTC to 4:00 UTC will be sometime between 4:00 and 5:00 UTC.
How do I claim my rewards?
Eligible @xStocksFi tokenized stocks: NVDAx, TSLAx, AAPLx, AMZNx, TTWOx, QQQx, SPYx
